description:
SBA custom UI: a "Live Metrics" page — replicates the standard Metrics view but
        renders each selected metric as a live, rolling time-series line chart (like the CPU/Memory
        graphs on the Overview page) instead of a one-shot value. The user picks an instance + metric
        (+ optional tag filters) and adds a graph; graphs poll the instance's actuator on an interval,
        can be removed, and persist across reloads via localStorage. Built with Vite/Vue and shipped
        as a resources jar under META-INF/spring-boot-admin-server-ui/extensions/live-metrics.
